summary: The Import Settings window now resizes from its top-left corner and its dropdowns no longer scroll sideways.
details: Dragging the bottom-right corner used to widen the window on both sides at once; the left edge now stays put and the window grows toward the pointer.
The grip glyph in the bottom-right corner of the window was removed.
Dropdown lists no longer show a horizontal scrollbar: long table names are shortened with an ellipsis instead.
